### Evidence table

All citations refer to **S0043**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/r2/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Aspect | Observed evidence |
|---|---|
| Goal | The student was instructed to reconstruct an indoor RGB photograph as an editable SceneAct/Blender scene, with separate meshes, materials, and a matching camera; the request supplied a 512 × 341 image path and a budget for five model calls and three executions (line 1, `model_request`, characters [0,9034)). The intended semantic goal was visual resemblance; the photograph itself is not visible in these observations. |
| Actual operations | A fresh, read-only Codex student session was launched with the staged image. It reported failure, exit code 1, zero tool calls, and no observable model-turn count (line 2, `codex_session`, [0,2634)). The subsequent student `model_error` points to a stderr log; the `scene_error` traceback shows failure while requesting the student response (lines 3 [0,552), 4 [0,1614)). |
| Changes and validation | No student program, scene build, execution, render, revision, or visual comparison is recorded. Thus there is no evidence of multiple objects, materials or textures, connected parts, or pose in a constructed scene. Camera, lighting, and render quality are likewise unassessable—not demonstrated defects. |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or execution appears in this student trajectory; receipt and adoption are therefore not evidenced. No autonomous exploration is recorded; the session reports zero tool calls (line 2). |
| Outcome | **Technical interruption**, not a demonstrated reconstruction-algorithm failure, partial visual correctness, or formal success. The exit status and traceback establish where the request failed, but not why: the cited stderr contents are not supplied. The final scene outcome is unknown. |

**Transferable lesson:** A failed model request provides no render from which to judge geometry or visual quality; diagnose the actual execution error before making reconstruction claims. **Task-specific uncertainty:** Neither the reference image contents nor the stderr log is included, so object identities, scene fidelity, and the cause of the exit remain unresolved hypotheses.
